entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey a while ago, and I'm just so confused about what to do. The website was a bit overwhelming.
Of course, I can certainly help clarify things for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just the fit. I finally tried it on and it's definitely the wrong size. It feels way too tight in the shoulders. I think I need to exchange it, but I couldn't figure out the policy. Can't you just help me?
Absolutely. I can definitely walk you through the process for an exchange. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, let me see... yes, it's VF-881-923-54.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. VF-881-923-54... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Cycling Jersey. It looks like it was delivered to you 85 days ago.
Oh no, has it been that long? I'm sorry, I was just so busy. Is that a problem?
Not at all. Since this jersey is a standard item, it falls under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe for a return or exchange.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it.

I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. Just pack the original jersey and drop it off with the label. We'll ship out the next size up as soon as the return is scanned. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect! Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
